findings.value: A nature reserve in Bethnal Green on a former WW2 bomb site, looked after by local volunteers since 1977. It describes itself as a cultural institute for ecological research and community learning.

evidence.quote: The Bethnal Green Nature Reserve is a cultural institute focused on ecological research and community learning in the heart of East London.
This space is a WW2 bomb-site that has been cared for since 1977 by local residents, volunteers, staff, trustees
The Bethnal Green Nature Reserve is a cultural institute dedicated to ecological research and community learning in the heart of East London.

notes: Found through the venue's own about page and a 2026 London Open Gardens entry (London Parks & Gardens Trust). The entry lists a medicine garden, a mushroom farm and wetlands. No independent press review was found. Web search budget ran out, so the press search was incomplete.
